spans.s: --a month. On the एकादशि day is to be per- formed मन्वन्तरादि s4ra1ddha; on the अष्टमि शम्भु is to be worshipped. M. १७. 7; ५६. 2; ६०. ३५.
--the blue colour; of विष्णु (प्रादुर्भाव). M. १७१. ६४ and ७०.
--the मन्त्रस् of the Atharvavedins recited in tank ritual. M. २४. ४६; ५८. ३७.
(I)--one of the two best सामगस्. वा. ६१. ४८.

(II)--(पौष्पिन्जि-वि। प्।) a disciple of Sukarma among the disciples of the North given by Indra; taught the five hundred Samhitas; लन्गाक्षि and Mangali were some of his disciples;
1: भा.
